MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Ethernet switch feels like a useful next step after my USB Ethernet adapter and patch cables because it lets me connect more devices by wire.",
    "The short Ethernet cables complement the switch and my existing longer cables, helping me keep nearby desk connections tidy."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable repeats something I already have without addressing a new need; the shorter Ethernet cables serve a different purpose from my existing cables.",
    "The streaming sticks, smart plug, camera, and Echo Dot introduce activities I am not currently pursuing while I am finishing my computer and wired networking setup.",
    "The large drives assume I need substantial storage, but my memory card purchases do not establish a need for a 16TB drive or a compatible 4TB internal SSD."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been treated as interest in a broad range of electronic devices, even when they do not help with my current setup.",
    "My older HDMI and Raspberry Pi purchases seem to have been taken as ongoing interest in streaming equipment, although my latest purchases point toward wired connections and desk upkeep."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter and patch cables together suggest a connected project, making accessories that extend that setup especially relevant.",
    "My headphone mount, cable management supplies, and cleaning equipment suggest that organizing and maintaining my existing equipment matters to me.",
    "An accessory is useful when it fills a specific gap; another cable or storage device needs a distinct purpose and suitable compatibility."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my wired networking project but stretch my electronics purchases into unrelated entertainment, home automation, and storage needs."
}
